title: Jana Nayagan Box Office Collection Day 4 Highlights: After Rs 200 cr plus opening weekend, Vijay’s film struggles on Monday
summary: Thalapathy Vijay’s political thriller Jana Nayagan posted a Rs 200 crore-plus worldwide opening weekend and Rs 32 crore net on Day 4 in India, taking the four-day India net to Rs 124.75 crore. The film showed strong occupancies in Tamil Nadu cities but experienced weekday slowdown and mixed critical response. Overseas markets and ticket sales remained robust, while debates around politics, reviews and theatre incidents continued.
content:
Tamil Nadu Chief Minister and actor Vijay’s latest release Jana Nayagan has maintained an upward trajectory at the box office despite opening to mixed reviews on July 23. After crossing the Rs 100 crore net mark in India within three days, the political thriller earned Rs 32 crore net on Sunday. With this, its total India net collection has reached Rs 124.75 crore, while the India gross stands at Rs 145.98 crore. Worldwide, Jana Nayagan has grossed Rs 217.48 crore.

On Day 4, Jana Nayagan saw an overall 69.04% occupancy across 12,107 shows, with morning shows at 59.23%, afternoon shows at 76.62%, evening shows at 78.46%, and night shows at 61.85%.

Coimbatore and Chennai emerged as the strongest markets, recording overall occupancies of 93.5% and 91.8%, respectively. Bengaluru, meanwhile, posted a relatively lower overall occupancy of 54.3%.

Director H. Vinoth commented on the film’s reception: "Whenever a Vijay sir movie comes out, for about a week people say this is good, that isn’t good, this doesn’t work, that doesn’t, and all that. Then after a week, they say it’s not that great after all. Six months later, it starts becoming a big hit in society," he told Rangaraj Pandey.

Besides Vijay, Jana Nayagan also stars Pooja Hegde, Bobby Deol, Mamitha Baiju, Priyamani, Gautham Vasudev Menon, Prakash Raj and others. Produced by Venkat K. Narayana under the banner of KVN Productions, the movie’s music has been composed by Anirudh Ravichander.

Trade tracker Sacnilk provided rolling updates through Monday evening: the film was reported across varying show counts as the day progressed—10,197 shows with Rs 6.70 crore net as of 9 pm, 9,100 shows with Rs 6.02 crore net as of 8 pm, 8,010 shows with Rs 5.29 crore net as of 7 pm, 7,785 shows with Rs 4.20 crore net as of 6 pm, 7,186 shows with Rs 3.79 crore net as of 5 pm, and 5,038 shows nationwide with an estimated Rs 1.96 crore net by 2 pm on Day 5.

Trade analyst Sreedhar Pillai told HT, "Definitely it will be a big hit because of the magic and the aura surrounding Vijay, especially after he became the Tamil Nadu chief minister."

In another interview, H. Vinoth said he avoids most reviews and is cautious about distinguishing paid or influenced assessments from genuine feedback: "If there is genuine feedback, I’ll definitely accept it. From day one, I knew Jana Nayagan was a complete commercial entertainer... Any review should see how we have made Jana Nayagan in relation to that instead of judging it as a new film."

Vinoth also recalled emotional moments on set: "He hugged me and said, 'At last,' and smiled. He was happy with the film. The producer, Venkat K. Narayana, endured the most difficulty, but it’s a lifetime, though costly, memory for him."

User reactions on Letterboxd ranged from affectionate tributes to critical takes. One user praised Vijay’s emotional connection with fans while noting pacing and CGI issues. Another called the film a political launchpad more than a pure cinematic statement, lamenting fan-service moments. Fans on social media celebrated theatrical scenes, including visuals from Madurai showing women wearing masks of Chief Minister Joseph Vijay.

Contentious incidents included reports of screenings being halted at several Chennai theatres after minors were found watching the film despite its 'A' (Adults Only) certification; theatre staff reportedly stopped or delayed shows and asked parents to remove children from auditoriums in compliance with CBFC rules.

Internationally, Jana Nayagan opened strong in North America with about $611,000 from premieres and Day 1 across 411 locations, then added roughly $250,000 on Friday, $270,000 on Saturday and around $150,000 early Sunday estimates from 324 locations, taking North American totals close to $1.3 million. The film collected Rs 71.50 crore gross overseas in four days, helping the worldwide gross reach Rs 217.48 crore.

Ticket sales and footfalls were notable: an estimated 3.15 million tickets sold during the four-day opening weekend and approximately 4.81 million footfalls across India. While Jana Nayagan trailed all-time Tamil openings like Leo and Jailer, it outperformed several recent big releases and comfortably surpassed GOAT's opening weekend ticket numbers.

Rentrak listed Jana Nayagan at No. 7 on its Global/International Weekend Box Office Top 10 for July 24–26, 2026, with an estimated $21.82 million (approximately Rs 210.5 crore) opening weekend worldwide. Trade analyst Ramesh Bala and others hailed the film’s global performance and record Day 4 in Tamil Nadu.

Box-office breakdown by language on Day 4: the Tamil version led with Rs 27.30 crore at about 67.0% occupancy across 6,347 shows; the Hindi version added Rs 3.35 crore from 4,557 shows at 19.0% occupancy; the Telugu version contributed Rs 1.35 crore at 24.0% occupancy across 1,203 shows.

The film marked Vijay’s third biggest opening weekend in India (net) with Rs 124.75 crore across four days, behind Leo and GOAT but ahead of Beast, Sarkar, Master and Varisu. Jana Nayagan is also only the second Tamil film of 2026 to cross the Rs 100 crore domestic net mark.

Director H. Vinoth said there are six deleted scenes featuring Vijay that the team plans to release soon. Music director Anirudh Ravichander posted on X about the emotional journey and memories created across his collaborations with Vijay.

Analysts and fans noted that, despite leaks and delays, the film’s theatrical performance remained strong, driven by Vijay’s fanbase and global appeal. Observers pointed to a mix of word-of-mouth, fan celebrations and box-office momentum that could sustain the run despite weekday dips and mixed critical reaction.

Vinoth opened up about the response to his film Jana Nayagan. “Whenever a Vijay sir movie comes out, for about a week people say this is good, that isn’t good, this doesn’t work, that doesn’t, and all that. Then after a week, they say it’s not that great after all. Six months later, it starts becoming a big hit in society,” he told Rangaraj Pandey.

Besides Vijay, Jana Nayagan also stars Pooja Hegde, Bobby Deol, Mamitha Baiju, Priyamani, Gautham Vasudev Menon, Prakash Raj and others. Produced by Venkat K. Narayana under the banner of KVN Productions, the movie’s music has been composed by Anirudh Ravichander.

Trade analyst Sreedhar Pillai told HT, "Definitely it will be a big hit because of the magic and the aura surrounding Vijay, especially after he became the Tamil Nadu chief minister."

According to trade tracker Sacnilk, Vijay-starrer Jana Nayagan, currently running across 9,100 shows, has collected Rs 6.02 crore net as of 8 pm on Monday.

In an interview with NDTV, Jana Nayagan director H Vinoth said, "I haven't read most of the reviews. Moreover, we need to look at which is a paid review and which is a genuine one - in today's age of PR culture, where there is organised influencer marketing that extends to reviews, we need to assess what is real. If there is genuine feedback, I'll definitely accept it. From day one, I knew Jana Nayagan was a complete commercial entertainer, and we have a reference movie (Bhagavanth Kesari) too. Any review should see how we have made Jana Nayagan in relation to that instead of judging it as a new film. In today's world, it's become difficult to find out which journalist is being honest, and I don't want to mentally stress myself over that."

In an interview with NDTV, Jana Nayagan director H Vinoth said, "He hugged me and said, 'At last,' and smiled. He was happy with the film. The producer, Venkat K. Narayana, endured the most difficulty, but it's a lifetime, though costly, memory for him. In the future, if there's anything I can do for the producer, I will."

A note by user Dhanu Kemathas on Letterboxd, "Jana Nayagan does not reach the same level of impact, influence, or storytelling excellence as some of Thalapathy Vijay’s most acclaimed films, such as Kaththi, Thuppakki, Master, and Ghilli. While the film is hindered by pacing issues, inconsistent CGI, and several logical flaws, it remains an entertaining action drama that is likely to appeal to Vijay’s dedicated fan-base.

He added, "On a side note: Thank you, Vijay sir, for making our childhood feel like magic, our teenage-hood feel like a rebellion, and our adulthood feel like a journey worth taking. You were never just an actor. You were a feeling. A motivation. A reason to dream. A friend we never met, yet grew up with. In every role, you left a piece of your heart, and in doing so, you became a part of ours. Some stars live on screen. You live in our lives forever."

According to trade tracker Sacnilk, Vijay-starrer Jana Nayagan, currently running across 8,010 shows, has collected Rs 5.29 crore net as of 7 pm on Monday.

User AjaySurya wrote on Letterboxd, "This felt less like a film and more like a launchpad for Vijay's political journey. As a movie, it didn't do much for me. You can watch it for the dance, the action, and a few emotional moments especially knowing this is his final film. That said, I'll genuinely miss actor Vijay. Whatever your opinion of his films, there's no denying the entertainer he has been for decades. Coming back to the movie, though there were way too many cringe moments, starting with the TVK references and plenty more that felt more like fan service than storytelling. I just wish his final film had been remembered more for its cinema than its politics."

User kirthe wrote on Letterboxd, "Movie was a not bad, but as a vijay fan that dance sequence was too personal, nostalgia max and a true treat. Honestly it could've been more tribute worthy like GOAT, but ofc he had his own agenda."

According to trade tracker Sacnilk, Vijay-starrer Jana Nayagan, currently running across 7,785 shows, has collected Rs 4.20 crore net as of 6 pm on Monday.

Jana Nayagan director H Vinoth told Behindwoods, "If Jana Nayagan was released on Pongal, the box office collection could have been five times higher than what the film has collected now. It could have been more relevant and helped Vijay sir more for his politics."

Jana Nayagan director H Vinoth told Behindwoods, "There are six deleted scenes in Jana Nayagan, involving Vijay sir. We are planning to release all the scenes. I will give it to the production house soon. Producers will plan and the deleted scenes will come one by one from next week onwards."

According to trade tracker Sacnilk, Vijay-starrer Jana Nayagan, currently running across 7,186 shows, has collected Rs 3.79 crore net as of 5 pm on Monday.

Jana Nayagan music director Anirudh Ravichander said via X, "It has been a thoroughly amazing and emotional journey with you through Jana Nayagan, Leo, Beast, Master and Kaththi. Thank you @actorvijay sir for the unlimited trust and memories that I will cherish forever. The music lives on."

A fan @Naveen_Saaho_41 shared via X, "The word of mouth for #jananayagan is getting stronger with every show! Neutral audiences are embracing the film, weekend bookings are A beautifully crafted theatrical experience, especially for every Thalapathy fan!"

Adding to the celebrations, videos from Madurai showed women watching Jana Nayagan while wearing masks of Chief Minister Joseph Vijay, turning theatres into festive venues. The visuals, widely shared on social media.

Ahimsa Entertainment shared via X, "A film delayed for months. Leaked in HD before it even hit cinemas. By every rule in the book, numbers like these should be impossible. But Thalapathy has never played by the book. And for the curious — back when #jananayagan was locked for January, just our Day 1 pre-sales alone had already blown past £600K the night before release, charging straight towards the BIGGEST Indian opening the UK has ever witnessed. This time, we’re not chasing box office records. This is THALAPATHY’S FAREWELL — and we’ll celebrate it like the once-in-a-lifetime moment it is."

Screenings of Thalapathy Vijay's Jana Nayagan were reportedly halted at several theatres in Chennai after authorities found minors watching the film despite its 'A' (Adults Only) certification. Theatre staff stopped or delayed shows and asked parents who had brought children into the auditoriums to leave, in compliance with the CBFC's certification rules.

According to Sacnilk, Jana Nayagan continues to hold steady at the box office on Day 5 despite the expected weekday slowdown. As of the latest update, the Thalapathy Vijay starrer is running across 5,038 shows nationwide and has collected an estimated Rs 1.96 crore net in India by 2 pm.

Actor Dhanush has sparked fresh speculation about a possible political entry after urging his fans to channel their collective strength into social service. Speaking at a blood donation camp organised by his fan clubs in Chennai, the actor encouraged supporters to go beyond celebrating his films and engage in welfare activities by helping people in their local communities. His remarks quickly went viral, with many on social media drawing comparisons to Thalapathy Vijay's journey from cinema to politics, where fan clubs eventually evolved into a political support network.READ MORE

A fan @madhu____0 has praised Jana Nayagan's strong box office momentum, claiming that the film's overwhelming responseand shared via X, "Excellent response from the neutral audience is driving #jananayagan to the next level! Strong weekend bookings, positive WOM indicate a solid long run ahead. A perfectly crafted celebration for Thalapathy fans! @ActorVijay @KvnProductions."

Jana Nayagan has also registered an impressive run in international markets, underlining Thalapathy Vijay's global box office pull. According to Sacnilk, the film opened with a strong $611,000 from premieres and Day 1 across 411 locations in North America. While collections settled after the initial rush, the film maintained steady momentum, earning around $250,000 on Friday and witnessing a slight jump to $270,000 on Saturday. Early Sunday estimates from 324 locations added another $150,000, taking the film's North American total close to the $1.3 million mark.

Vijay film's overseas performance has been impressive, with Rs 71.50 crore gross collected from international markets in just four days.

According to Sacnilk, Jana Nayagan has delivered an impressive performance in overseas markets, reaffirming Thalapathy Vijay's immense global fan following. One of the film's biggest achievements came in Singapore, where it debuted at No. 2 on the Shaw Theatres Top 10 chart across the leading multiplex chain. The Vijay starrer outperformed several major Hollywood releases and finished behind only The Odyssey, highlighting its exceptional reception in a key international market.

Jana Nayagan has emerged as one of the biggest ticket sellers on BookMyShow, recording an estimated 3.15 million tickets sold during its four-day opening weekend and generating approximately 4.81 million footfalls across India. While the Vijay starrer remains behind all-time record holders Leo (4.86 million tickets) and Jailer (4.85 million tickets), it has comfortably surpassed The Greatest of All Time (GOAT), which sold 2.88 million tickets during its opening weekend.

According to Sacnilk, Jana Nayagan continues its impressive theatrical run on Day 5, despite the expected weekday slowdown. As of the latest update by 12 pm, the Thalapathy Vijay starrer is running across 3,095 shows nationwide and has collected an estimated Rs 1.14 crore net in India. With these figures, the film's total India gross has reached Rs 147.33 crore, while its India net collection stands at Rs 125.89 crore.

Despite its blockbuster box office performance, Jana Nayagan has received mixed critical reactions. Only one half of the film truly works, stating that the emotionally engaging portions are those adapted from Anil Ravipudi's Telugu hit Bhagavanth Kesari, while director H. Vinoth's newly added elements fail to have the same impact.READ MORE

An emotional fan of Thalapathy Vijay shared that after completing his Day 4 theatre visit for Jana Nayagan, he was overwhelmed by the massive turnout of children and families. The fan @CJV_MSD wrote, "I've finished my Day 4 count... Brother, please change your decision. The theatres are completely packed with kids and families. All of this love is only for you. The next generation of actors may never witness something like this. #jananayagan"

Thalapathy Vijay's Jana Nayagan has achieved another major milestone by securing a place in Rentrak's Global/International Weekend Box Office Top 10 for the weekend of July 24–26, 2026. The film debuted at No. 7 on the worldwide chart with an impressive opening weekend gross of $21.82 million (approximately Rs 210.5 crore) across international and domestic markets. According to the Rentrak estimates, Jana Nayagan earned $20.47 million internationally and $1.35 million domestically, reaffirming its strong global appeal. The Vijay starrer shared the chart with major Hollywood releases such as The Odyssey, Toy Story 5, Moana, and Minions & Monsters, making it one of the few Indian films to feature among the world's highest-grossing films of the weekend.

Trade analyst Ramesh Bala took to X to post, "Rentrak Top 10. Global domination. #jananayagan storms into the Worldwide Top 10 (July 23–26) with a phenomenal $21.82M (Rs 210.5 Cr) opening weekend. Back home, #thalapathyvijay creates history again with a record-breaking Day 4 in Tamil Nadu."

Kerala Box Office shared via X, "Back to Back 9 ₹200cr movies in the past 9 years since Mersal. He doesn't need positive reviews, brand director's, massive budget anything. Just Thalapathy Vijay the name is enough. #jananayagan."

Trade analyst Laxmi Kanth took to X to share, "#jananayagan - has created a New Record in TN.. All Time Highest Day 4 Collections for any Movie in TN.. Film comfortably Crossed 200cr Mark WW within its 4 Day Opening Weekend.. With this, #thalapathyvijay now has Thirteen 10cr+ Grossers in Kerala.. No major releases this week except Spider-Man, the film has a good run on the cards.. Once again, Thalapathy has proved that he's above every negative circumstance.."

With a 4-day India net collection of Rs 124.75 crore, Jana Nayagan has delivered Thalapathy Vijay's third biggest opening weekend at the domestic box office. The film trails only Leo and The Greatest of All Time (GOAT) in the actor's career, while comfortably surpassing the opening weekend numbers of Beast, Sarkar, Master, and Varisu.

Here are Thalapathy Vijay's Biggest Opening Weekends in India (Net):

Leo (2023) – Rs 177.15 crore (4-day weekend)

The Greatest of All Time – GOAT (2024) – Rs 137.00 crore (4-day weekend)

Jana Nayagan (2026) – Rs 124.75 crore (4-day weekend)

Beast (2022) – Rs 112.30 crore (5-day extended weekend)

Sarkar (2018) – Rs 107.05 crore (6-day extended weekend)

Master (2021) – Rs 96.40 crore (5-day extended weekend)

Varisu (2023) – Rs 87.25 crore (5-day extended weekend)

With its latest box office collections, Jana Nayagan has become only the second Tamil film of 2026 to cross the Rs 100 crore mark at the domestic box office. The Vijay starrer has now amassed Rs 124.75 crore net in India, joining Suriya's Karuppu, which currently tops the list with a lifetime India net collection of Rs 198 crore.

The Tamil version of Jana Nayagan continued to dominate on Day 4, registering an impressive 69.04% overall occupancy. The film opened with 59.23% occupancy in the morning shows before witnessing a sharp jump to 76.62% in the afternoon and peaking at 78.46% during the evening shows. Night shows maintained a solid 61.85% occupancy.

Jana Nayagan earned an impressive Rs 32.00 crore net in India on Day 4, taking its total India net collection to Rs 124.75 crore. The Tamil version remained the biggest contributor with Rs 27.30 crore at a stellar 67.0% occupancy across 6,347 shows. The Hindi version added Rs 3.35 crore with 19.0% occupancy from 4,557 shows, while the Telugu version contributed Rs 1.35 crore at 24.0% occupancy across 1,203 shows.

Jana Nayagan witnessed another strong day at the box office, with its Day 4 net collection of Rs 32.00 crore marking a 10.7% growth over Day 3's Rs 28.90 crore.

Jana Nayagan continued its strong global box office run on Day 4, earning Rs 10.00 crore from overseas markets. With this, the film's total overseas gross has reached Rs 71.50 crore. The worldwide gross collection has now climbed to Rs 217.48 crore.

Thalapathy Vijay's Jana Nayagan continues its impressive box office run. According to Sacnilk, the film collected an estimated Rs 32.00 crore net on Day 4 across 12,107 shows nationwide. With this, the film's total India net collection has climbed to Rs 124.75 crore, while its India gross stands at Rs 145.98 crore so far.
